gloss: to endure; to bear; to put up with

definitions.gloss: to endure; to bear; to put up with
definitions.explanation: To withstand pain, hardship, or unpleasant situations without giving in or expressing it outwardly.
To restrain oneself from expressing emotions such as tears, laughter, or anger.

examples.japanese: {痛|いた}みを{堪|こら}えて{走|はし}り{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: I endured the pain and kept running.

examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}さを{堪|こら}えて{外|そと}で{待|ま}った。
examples.english: I endured the cold and waited outside.

examples.japanese: {辛|つら}い{時期|じき}を{堪|こら}えて{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた。
examples.english: I endured the difficult period and got through it.

examples.japanese: {笑|わら}いを{堪|こら}えるのが{大変|たいへん}だった。
examples.english: It was hard to hold back my laughter.

examples.japanese: {怒|いか}りを{堪|こら}えて{冷静|れいせい}に{話|はな}した。
examples.english: I suppressed my anger and spoke calmly.

notes:
{堪|こら}える emphasizes internal fortitude and self-control.

KANJI NOTE:
Alternatively written as {耐|こら}える, though {堪|こら}える is more common. Both share the sense of endurance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {痛|いた}みを{堪|こら}える: to endure pain
- {涙|なみだ}を{堪|こら}える: to hold back tears
- {笑|わら}いを{堪|こら}える: to suppress laughter
- {空腹|くうふく}を{堪|こら}える: to endure hunger

RELATED WORDS:
- {耐|た}える: to endure, withstand (more formal)
- {我慢|がまん}する: to be patient, put up with
